note: Baseline freeze for the dead-export gate (scripts/check-dead-exports.mjs). Each entry is a pre-existing export ts-prune flags as unused, categorized honestly: 'config-referenced' = a real false positive (Playwright registers it by config-string path, which ts-prune cannot resolve); 'public-api-surface' / 'public-api-barrel' = an intentional exported type/utility surface; 'test-data-surface' = an authored spec-data constant with no current consumer. Standing up the gate does not delete shipped client exports or authored test-data; a separate code-quality pass (under a spec/data owner identity) may remove the truly-orphaned ones later. The gate's forward value is catching a NEW dead export in a staged client file.
